item.title: Femsa, Oxxo’s owner, cuts workforce related to its fintech unit Spin
item.description: Spin, a debit and points-earning card accessible via any of Mexico's 24,000 Oxxo stores, has attracted 16 million users in five years. item.title: Mexico expecting over 4 million tourists during Holy Week holiday
item.description: Tourism Minister Josefina Rodríguez Zamora announced that 4.03 million tourists are expected at the country's top destinations — a 2.6% increase over the 3.93 million recorded during the same period of 2025. item.title: Clock ticks on remodel of Mexico City International Airport as World Cup nears
item.description: Renovations at both terminals of Mexico City International Airport (AICM) are only around half complete after 10 months of construction, meaning they will not be finished in time for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, according to the airport’s director general.
